name: WebStorm
summary: Automatic error reports are on by default in release builds. Anonymous usage statistics and detailed code-related data are off by default for commercial licenses, but on by default for the non-commercial license. JetBrains receives the data, stored in the EU. The help page says the non-commercial license cannot disable the consent, while JetBrains' legal notice says non-commercial users can opt out, so those sources conflict.

optOut.instructions: Open Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing and clear the checkboxes for error reports, usage statistics and detailed code-related data.
